name: send_webhook
description: Send a named webhook or a direct webhook URL to trigger an external automation. Use for 'trigger the slack webhook', 'send the home assistant webhook', or 'list my webhooks'. Each named webhook is a separate destination. A test or sample request must use the destination the user requested; do not send to an unrelated logger or a webhook merely because its name contains 'test'. Before sending to an unfamiliar named webhook, use webhook='list' with data={} to read its required fields, optional payload schema, and example. Build data to match that destination's contract; do not invent a test action. For a single complete contract, use the destination name with describe=true and data={}; listing and inspection send no webhook. Outbound attempts are rate limited to prevent duplicates. Not for sending email; use send_email.

webhook.description: Exact name of the requested destination from the registry (e.g., 'notify_slack', 'home_assistant'). Named webhooks are separate services, not test modes or prerequisites for one another. Use 'list' to see configured webhooks.

url.description: Final direct webhook URL (alternative to named webhook). All HTTP 3xx responses are refused for security.

describe.description: Read the selected named webhook's complete payload contract without sending it. Use webhook=<name>, describe=true, data={} when a catalog was compacted or the body requirements are unclear.

data.description: JSON object sent unchanged as the webhook body. Named destinations can require specific fields, nested structure, or actions: read their contract with webhook='list' first. Use {} when listing. Use {} with describe=true for read-only contract inspection.

headers.description: Optional literal HTTP headers to include in the request. Environment placeholders such as ${API_KEY} are rejected; use a named registry webhook for credential headers.
